asOf.description: When the figures were last published (UTC). Trades and transfers settled shortly before may not be included yet.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid in the period net of rebates, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

holdings.description: Assets held now, ordered by asset_id.

costUsd.description: USD cost of the quantity with a known cost: what it cost when acquired, fees in the asset included. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

entryPriceUsd.description: Average entry price in USD per unit: cost_usd divided by the quantity with a known cost. Omitted when no quantity has a known cost.

markPriceUsd.description: Current USD price per unit used for unrealized PnL. Omitted when not available.

positionQuantity.description: Quantity held, in whole units of the asset: position_quantity = quantity with a known cost plus untracked_quantity. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

unrealizedPnlUsd.description: Unrealized PnL in USD: the quantity with a known cost valued at mark_price_usd, minus cost_usd. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when mark_price_usd is.

untrackedQuantity.description: Quantity whose cost is unknown, such as deposited coins, in whole units of the asset. It never counts toward PnL. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

markTime.description: Time of the prices that value holdings now (UTC): the close of the latest complete minute.

markets.description: Realized PnL by market, ordered by symbol_id.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid in the period, net of rebates received, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string: negative when rebates exceed fees.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after their fees: each sale realizes its proceeds minus the average cost of what it sold, and each fee is a realized expense. Signed base-10 decimal string.

tradeCount.description: Fills of the account in the market in the period.

volumeUsd.description: Traded volume in USD: execution price times quantity, valued at the execution time. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

notices.description: What the figures leave out, if anything.

pnlUsd.description: PnL in USD over the period: realized_pnl_usd plus the change in unrealized PnL from the period's start to now, with deposits, withdrawals and transfers neutral. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid net of rebates in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the product's trades in the period, after fees. Signed base-10 decimal string.

volumeUsd.description: Traded volume in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after fees. Signed base-10 decimal string.

unrealizedPnlChangeUsd.description: Change in unrealized PnL in USD from the period's start to now, net of transfers in and out. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

unrealizedPnlUsd.description: Unrealized PnL in USD of the holdings now. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

volumeUsd.description: Traded volume in the period, in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

asOf.description: When the figures were last published (UTC). Trades settled shortly before may not be included yet.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid net of rebates in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

maxDrawdownPct.description: Largest fall in percent of the compounded return from a previous peak, at day closes. Non-negative base-10 decimal string. Omitted as return_pct is.

notices.description: What the figures leave out, if anything.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after fees. Signed base-10 decimal string.

returnDays.description: Daily returns the return figures are based on: the closed days of their period from the account's first deposit on. Today never counts.

returnPct.description: Time-weighted return in percent over closed days only: for DAYS_7 and DAYS_30, the 7 or 30 closed UTC days ending at the latest 00:00 whose prices are final; every closed day for LIFETIME; none for TODAY. The daily returns are compounded, so deposits and withdrawals do not count as gains or losses. A day's return is (end - start - flow) / (start + flow / 2) of its equity and net flow; a day that starts with no equity starts at its first deposit, with return (end - flow) / flow. Signed base-10 decimal string, such as "1.25" for 1.25%. The return figures cover the whole account, whatever symbol_id and product select. Omitted when a day's equity or net flow is not available, or when the period has no closed day.

sharpe.description: Annualized Sharpe ratio of the daily returns: their mean divided by their sample standard deviation, times the square root of 365, with no risk-free rate. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted with notice SHARPE_INSUFFICIENT_DAYS for fewer than 7 daily returns; omitted also when the returns do not vary, or as return_pct is.

tradeCount.description: Fills of the account in the period.

volumeUsd.description: Traded volume in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

asOf.description: When the figures were last published (UTC). Trades and transfers settled shortly before may not be included yet.

endEquityUsd.description: Equity in USD at 00:00 UTC that ends the day, valued as start_equity_usd. Omitted as start_equity_usd is, and for today until the day closes.

feesUsd.description: Fees paid in the day net of rebates, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

netFlowUsd.description: Net external flows of the day in USD: deposits and transfers in, minus withdrawals and transfers out, each valued at the USD price when it settled. Transfers between the main account and its own subaccounts count for a single subaccount and cancel out for the main account. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

notices.description: What the day's figures leave out, if anything.

pnlUsd.description: PnL in USD of the day: realized_pnl_usd plus the change in unrealized PnL from the previous day's close to this day's close, with transfers neutral. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

realizedPnlUsd.description: Realized PnL in USD of the day's trades, after fees. Signed base-10 decimal string.

startEquityUsd.description: Equity in USD at 00:00 UTC that starts the day: every asset the account owns, funds reserved by open orders and pending withdrawals included, valued at the price at that time. It equals the previous day's end_equity_usd. Non-negative base-10 decimal string. Omitted with notice EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE when a price it needs is not available, or after a day with notice UNCLASSIFIED_TRANSFER or QUANTITY_SHORTFALL.

tradeCount.description: Fills of the account in the day.

unrealizedPnlAtCloseUsd.description: Unrealized PnL in USD of the holdings at the day's close. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available, as for today before it closes.

volumeUsd.description: Traded volume in the day, in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE: The account's equity at a day's start or end is not available, so the equity figures and the returns that need them are omitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FLOW_UNVALUED: No USD price was available for some deposits, withdrawals or transfers, so the day's net flow and the returns that need it are omitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARK_UNAVAILABLE: A current or period-start price is not available yet for some holdings: their unrealized PnL, and every figure that includes it, is omitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: No USD price was available at the time of some trades or transfers, so their effect is not in the USD figures. Their quantities still count.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUANTITY_SHORTFALL: Some sales exceeded the quantity PnL knows the account held.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SHARPE_INSUFFICIENT_DAYS: Fewer than 7 daily returns are available in the period, so the Sharpe ratio is omitted. return_days says how many there are.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNCLASSIFIED_TRANSFER: Some balance changes have an unrecognized reason and are not counted.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAYS_30: Since 00:00 UTC 29 days ago: today and the 29 days before it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAYS_7: Since 00:00 UTC six days ago: today and the 6 days before it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIFETIME: Since 00:00 UTC of the day of the account's first trade or transfer.

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

parameters.description: Optional product filter; omit for every product.
parameters.name: product

parameters.description:
Public subaccount ID; omit for the main account with every subaccount it owns, or a subaccount API key's own subaccount.

parameters.description: Optional market filter; omit or 0 for every market.
